description: Rebuilt 29-10-2026 from VATSIM Switzerland's vACC 'Preferential Runway System' page (vacc.ch), cross-checked against a live LSZH ATIS read 2026-10-29 16:23 UTC (see modes.json for detail and docs/LSZH_RUNWAY_RESEARCH.md for sourcing). The page's UTC times (which differ between winter and summer) convert to the SAME local clock times either way: Morning ends 0600Z winter / 0500Z summer = 07:00 local on weekdays, 0800Z/0700Z = 09:00 local on weekends; Evening starts 2000Z/1900Z = 21:00 local on weekdays, 1900Z/1800Z = 20:00 local on weekends. Zurich's real schedule differs on weekends, but the engine does not yet support day-of-week rules (docs/TIME_BASED_RULES.md, TB-4) -- this plan uses the weekday hours (07:00/21:00) as the only band set, a known simplification, not a data error. A mode with no row in a band keeps the pack's default preference penalty and stays allowed, so wind can still override these preferences if it must (soft preference, hard eligibility).
